product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic provides an enterprise integration and AI automation platform that securely connects applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

pricing_page.notes: Public packages include Essential, Professional, and Enterprise One.

eng_blog.notes: Examples include test-automation infrastructure by QA Lead Sriswapna Pothana and GitOps/Kubernetes developer environments by former Staff Software Engineer Nilay Narlawar.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers API management, AgentCreator, and connector Snap Packs, among other topics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No qualifying titles appeared in the readable careers listings. The Applied AI Architect posting is categorized as Sales–Pre-Sales and is excluded under the requested AI-sales rule; the listings may not expose every dynamically loaded opening.

model_provider.value: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Azure OpenAI
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list names these providers for AI data processing; the product documentation also explicitly describes OpenAI integration.

compliance_certs.notes: The page claims SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA-HITECH certification, and GDPR compliance. ISO 27001 is attributed to AWS rather than SnapLogic itself.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the Sixth Street Growth-led financing on December 13, 2021. Series G is the funding-database classification; some other third-party profiles report inconsistent dates or round labels.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified in the funding history is from December 2021, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Senior Enterprise Account Executive openings are listed with application links.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, SnapLogic announced capabilities across SnapGPT, SnapLogic MCP Server, and AgentCreator for building and deploying enterprise AI agents.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A September 22, 2026 update reports that Chief Financial Officer Ahsan Malik had left the company.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The marketing-operations posting calls Marketo and Salesforce 'our suite of tools'; the SDR posting requires updating prospect interactions in Salesforce.
